related.title: 德基水力發電系統
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫；德基水力發電系統改以薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs; Techi Hydropower System centers on thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Hoover有效水頭與德基有效水頭，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到德基水力發電系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以水庫與泥砂邊界為起點，設計一項能區分「厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫」與「薄拱壩與大甲溪級聯能量」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare hoover effective head with techi effective head and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Techi Hydropower System, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from reservoir/sediment boundaries and propose an observation distinguishing thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs from thin-arch dams and dajia cascade energy, including uncertainty.

related.title: 大古力水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「洩洪隧道空蝕與摻氣槽」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；大古力水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Spillway-tunnel cavitation and aerators" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦1930 年代拱形重力壩的分塊澆置、管冷溫控與百年機組更新；大古力水電站則以重力壩、805 MW 級機組與灌溉抽水的多目標運轉為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on block placement and pipe cooling of a 1930s arch-gravity dam and a century of unit renewal; Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant centres on multi-purpose operation of a gravity dam, 805 MW-class units and irrigation pumping, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「同步轉速與發電機極數」的模型移到大古力水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「班克斯湖抽水與灌溉」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Synchronous speed and generator poles" to Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Pumping to Banks Lake for irrigation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「洩洪隧道空蝕與摻氣槽」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；大古力水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Spillway-tunnel cavitation and aerators" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Grand Coulee Hydroelectric Power Plant must be respecified.

related.title: 三峽水電站發電系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「洩洪隧道空蝕與摻氣槽」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；三峽水電站發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Spillway-tunnel cavitation and aerators" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦1930 年代拱形重力壩的分塊澆置、管冷溫控與百年機組更新；三峽水電站發電系統則以巨型低水頭法蘭西斯機組、防洪調度與通航建築物的整合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on block placement and pipe cooling of a 1930s arch-gravity dam and a century of unit renewal; Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System centres on integrating giant low-head Francis units, flood operation and navigation structures, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「同步轉速與發電機極數」的模型移到三峽水電站發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水錘與導葉關閉規律」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Synchronous speed and generator poles" to Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Water hammer and guide-vane closure", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「洩洪隧道空蝕與摻氣槽」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；三峽水電站發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Spillway-tunnel cavitation and aerators" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 胡佛水壩水力發電系統
history.text: 胡佛水壩水力發電系統的公開資料展示厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System illustrate thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.
